{{CorrectTitle|title=ter-Stellan}}
The '''ter-Stellan''', or the "Exiled Ones," was a term used in the society of the [[Stellan (species)|Stellan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for those Stellan that their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Stellan (planet)|Stellan's]] ruling [[theocracy]] deemed to be a danger to the Stellan. The ter-Stellan were launched into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] aboard [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], with their subsequent fate being left to the will of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Magnificent">{{SW|url=news/the-not-so-magnificent-seven|text=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|int=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|nolive=1}}</ref>
